Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.description: Fleet configuration with station list and pump fleet directory

stations.description: List of active station numbers or identifiers

pumps.description: List of pump numbers or identifiers

stationPumps.description: Mapping of station names to assigned pump numbers

MaintenanceLog.title: MaintenanceLog
MaintenanceLog.description: Daily pump hours meter reading record for a specific station and pump

date.description: Date of meter reading in YYYY-MM-DD format

shift.description: Shift identifier: day, night, or legacy

pumpHours.description: Current pump runtime hours (null if unentered)

deckEngHours.description: Deck engine runtime hours (null if unentered)

notes.description: Optional notes for the pump reading

enteredBy.description: Name or identifier of technician who entered the record

finalized.description: Whether the daily sheet is finalized

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when created

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when last updated

PumpOpsEvent.title: PumpOpsEvent
PumpOpsEvent.description: Operational event or issue recorded for a pump during a shift (e.g. pump down, repair, return to service, swap)

eventType.description: Type of event: pump_down, repair_started, returned_to_service, derated, watch_item, pump_swap, general_note

status.description: Operational status: RUNNING, DERATED, DOWN, REPAIRING, STANDBY

stage.description: Stage number during which the event occurred

category.description: Issue category (e.g. FLUID END, POWER END, ENGINE)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when downtime or issue started

/fleets/{fleetId}.description: Fleet configuration and fleet directory containing stations and pumps

/fleets/{fleetId}/logs/{logId}.description: Pump maintenance logs for a specific fleet

/fleets/{fleetId}/pumpOpsEvents/{eventId.description: Operational pump events, pump downs, repairs, and handoff records
